headline: Ordinance adding Parking Enforcement Officer to pay rate schedule, and a Pawtucket Teachers' Alliance contract for 2026 to 2029.
summary: The meeting covers a proposed Parking Enforcement Officer position and its pay rate. It also covers a contract between the Pawtucket School Committee and the Pawtucket Teachers' Alliance.
items: Request to establish a Parking Enforcement Officer position, with Personnel Board recommendation
Ordinance to add Parking Enforcement Officer to the pay rate schedule for Local 3960 in Section §88-12 of the Code of Ordinances of the City of Pawtucket, 1996
Contract between the Pawtucket School Committee and the Pawtucket Teachers' Alliance, Local 930, for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2029
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, Second Floor – Room 204, Parking Lot Entrance at 75 Sabin Street, Pawtucket, RI
